Swimming Metrics–specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Swim workout marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general Fitness or Water Lock guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Swimming Metrics workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

游泳指标 vs 游泳数据 vs SWOLF

US pages say "Swimming Metrics", "Swim workout data", or "SWOLF score." China storefront copy often uses 游泳指标 for general swim-metrics positioning and chart headers, 游泳数据 when marketing emphasizes session history and trend dashboards, and SWOLF when gallery frames show the efficiency score readout Apple Watch displays during pool swims. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot frame — not one blanket term for every overlay.

Stroke count vs stroke type

Stroke count readouts (划水次数) differ from stroke type breakdowns (划水类型 — freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, butterfly). Stroke-count frames need 划水次数 — not 划水类型 on dedicated per-lap stroke-total overlays. Stroke-type pie charts need 划水类型 — not lap-count language on dedicated stroke-breakdown screenshots.

Lap count vs pool length splits

Lap count summaries (趟数) differ from pool length split tables showing 25 m or 50 m intervals (泳池长度分段). Lap-count frames need 趟数 — not generic 距离 alone on dedicated lap-total overlays. Pool-length split frames need 泳池长度 or 分段 — not open-water pace language on indoor pool screenshots.

Pool swim vs open water swim

Indoor pool swim sessions (泳池游泳) differ from open-water distance and pace summaries (开放水域游泳). Pool frames need 泳池游泳 — not 开放水域 on dedicated indoor lap-pool screenshots. Open-water frames need 开放水域游泳 — not pool-length split language on dedicated open-water route summaries.

Swimming Metrics vs Water Lock or Water Temperature

SWOLF and stroke count readouts (游泳指标 / 划水次数) differ from Water Lock crown-lock toggles (水下锁定) and external water-temperature sensor charts (水温). Swim metric frames need 游泳指标 or SWOLF — not 水下锁定 on SWOLF overlays, not 水温 on stroke-count charts. Water Lock and Water Temperature frames belong on their respective listing scopes — mention only as contrast when your gallery shows both on separate labeled screenshots.

Swimming Metrics vs Running Form

Pool and open-water swim metrics differ from running dynamics during outdoor runs (跑姿 / 触地时间 / 垂直振幅). Swim metric frames need 游泳指标 or 划水次数 — not 跑姿 on SWOLF charts, not 触地时间 on stroke-type overlays. Running Form frames belong on the Running Form listing guide — mention only as contrast when your gallery shows both on separate labeled screenshots.
